scope: Current published and qualified Linux/amd64 images for HEC-RAS 6.5, 6.6 and 7.0.1; full execution evidence remains external.

inventory_method.image_filesystem: Read-only, network-disabled ephemeral containers; normal entrypoint replaced by Linux Python -B.
inventory_method.linux_packages: Full dpkg-query inventory, including architecture and installed status; importlib.metadata for Linux Python distributions.

recreation_limits: This is an installed-package and source inventory, not an installation lock file or a guarantee of byte-identical rebuilding.
Vendor runtimes, original installers, prepared Wine prefixes, registry state and model data are not stored in Git.
The complete runtime.json artifact list is retained inside each image at the recorded path and in external build evidence.
